protocol.py: 2 biology problems (1 error, 1 note).

1. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: 9 stocks
   line 36:  p20.transfer(10, source_plate[src_well], dest_plate[dest_well], new_tip='never')
   At line 36 the tip went into src_A12 (well A12 in slot 2), src_B11 (well B11 in slot 2),
   src_C4 (well C4 in slot 2), src_C7 (well C7 in slot 2) and 5 more while it still carried
   src_A12 (well A12 in slot 2), src_B3 (well B3 in slot 2), src_B11 (well B11 in slot 2),
   src_C7 (well C7 in slot 2) and 5 more from an earlier step (this line did it 9 times). A
   tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so
   these stocks now hold material that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from them then
   took the unwanted material along into 9 other wells: wells A2, B1, B2, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1
   and 1 more in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A12, B11, C4, C7, D1, E5, F9, G2 and 1 more in slot 2.
   Also reached 9 other wells: wells A2, B1, B2, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and 1 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 36 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [35887fdca2e6]

2. NOTE WELL-CAPACITY: Declared more than the well holds: 500 ul in a 368 ul well, 10 wells
   line 36:  p20.transfer(10, source_plate[src_well], dest_plate[dest_well], new_tip='never')
   At line 36 the robot draws from well A12 in slot 2, which the protocol declares (line 19)
   to hold 500 ul; the well holds 368.01 ul, and 9 more are like it. The prep sheet cannot
   be followed as written. Wells: wells A12, B3, B11, C4, C7, D1, E5, F9 and 2 more in slot
   2.
   Affected: wells A12, B3, B11, C4, C7, D1, E5, F9 and 2 more in slot 2.
   Fix: Declare what the well can really hold, or use a bigger container.
   Source: Opentrons labware schema 2: totalLiquidVolume, the total well volume in
   microlitres
           https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Opentrons/opentrons/edge/shared-data/labware/schemas/2.json
   Source: Bartley et al. 2023, LabOP: a protocol never adds more liquid than its container
   holds
           https://jakebeal.github.io/Publications/JETC23-LabOP.pdf
   [79acef8a5f74]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.
